title: Lesson 20: General Systems Architecture: Environments and CI/CD in ML and AI Pipelines
description: The same environment-and-release discipline from Lesson 19, applied to machine learning and AI systems. Why the ML artifact is more than code (code, data, and model all change), the continuous X's (CI, CD, CT, CM), the MLOps maturity levels, how a model promotes from a development environment to production, and what changes when the artifact is a nondeterministic agent that needs eval gates instead of unit tests.
